name: Tiko Cards
subtitle: Picture cards that speak
promotional_text: Tap a picture card and Tiko speaks the word out loud — warm, instant and easy for early learners and AAC users.
description:
Tiko Cards is a gentle picture-communication app that gives every child a voice. Tap a picture card and Tiko speaks the word out loud — clear, immediate and calm.

Designed for early learners and for children who use AAC (augmentative and alternative communication), Cards keeps everything within easy reach. Words live in colourful collections you browse one tap at a time, so a child is never overwhelmed by choice.

Grown-ups can shape the board around the child. Add your own cards and categories with photos, colours and the exact words you want spoken, then arrange them however works best.

• Tap any picture card to hear it spoken aloud
• Colourful collections and sub-collections to organise words
• Add your own cards and categories with images, colours and custom speech
• Adjustable card and label sizes for easy reach and reading
• Speaks in multiple languages
• Child mode opens cards full-screen and keeps editing safely out of reach

Tiko Cards opens straight into the board — no login wall, no clutter — so communication can start the moment you need it.
